Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4s-r1 (the same class of defect: a G2 emitter defined below the main guard crashed PACK v28), FL-6 and the new row "FL-6b — export crash fix + live-registry export test" (your contract).

Fix: define `_emit_flame_dance` (and any sibling FL-6 emitters) at module scope above the main guard; ADD a test that runs the real CLI export command (the CS-pack-v43 command with --out under the test's temp dir, the live kits_v9.json, the real cells/parallax/props/sockets inputs) and asserts exit 0 + the emitted flame-dance scripts/resources present for fire_bolt_e1_B, fire_burst_e0p_v3 and blackwater_cocktail_e3 — the T4s-r1 lesson made permanent for every future emitter. No kit, spec or fixture changes. Acceptance (runs/C-5/t3/FL-6b/acceptance.json): the CLI export exit 0 with the live registry; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); 18 kits byte-identical; the new test green in the sandbox; remaining reds NAMED.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit, any spec, fixtures/, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-6b/. No Godot GUI. No deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-6b/.
